text.body: oma jaya gaṃgādhara hara| śiva jaya girijādhīśa, śiva jaya gaurīnātha| tvaṃ māṃ pālaya nityaṃ, tvaṃ māṃ pālaya śaṃbho, kṛpayā jagadīśa| oma hara hara hara mahādeva || dhṛ || kailāse giriśikhare kalpadrumavipine, śiva kalpadrumavipine, guṃjati madhukara puṃje, kuṃjavane gahane| kokila kūjati khelati haṃsāvalilalitā, śiva haṃsā valilalitā| racayati kalākalāpaṃ, nṛtyati mudasahitā, oma hara hara hara mahādeva || 1|| tasmiṃllalitasudeśe śālāmaṇiracitā, śiva śālāmaṇiracitā| tanmadhye haranikaṭe, gaurīmudasahitā| krīḍāṃ racayati bhūṣāṃ raṃjitanijamīśaṃ, śiva raṃjitanijamīśaṃ| indrādika surasevita, bramhādika surasevita praṇamati te śīrṣama, oma hara hara hara mahādeva|| 2|| vibudhavadhūrbahu nṛtyati hṛdaye mudasahitā, śiva hṛdaye mudasahitā| kinnaragānaṃ kurute, saptasvarasahitā| dhinakata thai thai dhinakata mṛdaṃga vādayate, śiva mṛdaṃga vādayate| kvaṇa kvaṇa lalitā veṇu, rmadhuraṃ nādayate, oma hara hara hara mahādeva|| 3|| ruṇu ruṇu caraṇe racayati nūpuramujvalitaṃ, śiva nūpuramujvalitaṃ| cakrāvarte bhramayati, kurute tāṃ dhika tāma| tāṃ tāṃ lupacupa tālaṃ nādayate, śiva tālaṃ nādayate| aṃguṣṭhāṃgulinādaṃ, lāsyakatāṃ kurute, oma hara hara hara mahādeva|| 4|| karpuradyutigauraṃ paṃcānanasahitaṃ, śiva paṃcānanasahitaṃ| trinayanaśaśidharamauliḥ,viṣadharaṃkaṇṭhayutama| sundarajaṭākalāpaṃ pāvakayutabhālaṃ śiva pāvakayutabhālaṃ| ḍamarutriśulapinākaṃ, karadhṛtanṛkapālaṃ, oma hara hara hara mahādeva || 5|| śaṃkhaninādaṃ kṛtvā jhallari nādayate, śiva jhallari nādayate| nīrājayate bramhā, nīrājayate viṣṇurvedaṛcāṃ paṭhate| iti mṛducaraṇasarojaṃ hṛtkamale dhṛtvā, śiva hṛtkamale dhṛtvā| avalokayati maheśaṃ, avalokayati sureśaṃ, īśama abhinatvā| oma hara hara hara mahādeva|| 6|| ruṇḍaiḥ racayati mālāṃ pannagamupavītaṃ, śiva pannagamupavītaṃ| vāmavibhāge girijā, vāmavibhāge gaurī rupamatilalitama| sundarasakalaśarīre kṛtabhasmābharaṇaṃ, śivakṛtabhasmābharaṇaṃ| iti vṛṣabhadhvajarupaṃ, haraśivaśaṃkararupaṃ, tāpatrayaharaṇaṃ, oma hara hara hara mahādeva || 7|| dhyānaṃ ārati samaye hṛdaye iti kṛtvā, śiva hṛdaye iti kṛtvā| rāmaṃ trijaṭānāthaṃ, īśama abhinatvā| saṃgītamevaṃ pratidinapaṭhanaṃ yaḥ kurute, śiva paṭhanaṃ yaḥ kurute| śivasāyujyaṃ gacchati, bhaktyā yaḥ śruṇute| oma hara hara hara mahādeva || 8|| oma jaya gaṃgādhara hara, śiva jaya girijādhīśa, śiva jaya gaurīnātha| tvaṃ māṃ pālaya nityaṃ, tvaṃ māṃ pālaya śambho, kṛpayā jagadīśa| oma hara hara hara mahādeva ||
